text: This is your first Pokémon, yes? Please raise it\nwith love and care.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0088_head_teacher_06
text: And of course, be sure to keep it tucked safely\ninside a Poké Ball.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0088_rival_01
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0100(0000)]... I can’t believe you\nactually\r\nchose [VAR 0x0101(0001)]...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0088_rival_02
text: I mean, like, way to make the perfect choice\nfor you! You two make such a good combo![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0088_rival_05
text: Can I choose one of these Pokémon too,\nDirector Clavell?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0088_head_teacher_07
text: Oh, but...did you not receive a Pokémon when\nyou entered the academy, Miss Nemona?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0088_rival_06
text: Not back then, no! I had other Pokémon I was\nfocused on raising at the time.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

text: Now that we’ve chosen our Pokémon, we HAVE\nto battle![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0088_rival_04
text: I’ll be waiting for you down at the beach.\nCome join me when you’re ready![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0088_head_teacher_03
text: As you may have noticed, Miss Nemona is a tad\noverly fond of Pokémon battling.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0088_head_teacher_04
text: But I do hope you’ll join her for a battle. It will\nhelp you get to know your own Pokémon as well.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0088_head_teacher_05
text: Miss Nemona was hoping you would join her at\nthe beach, wasn’t she? She’d be ever so happy\r\nif you agreed to a battle with her.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
